Carbon and biodiversity offsets only "work" if the gains they claim — stored
carbon, restored habitat, avoided clearing — stay in place over time.
**Permanence** is the question of whether they do, and for how long. This
walkthrough summarises an in-progress review of how permanence is treated
across major biodiversity and nature-based carbon offset schemes, and provides
an interactive database of the schemes covered.

Project repository: <https://github.com/alexdhond/offset-permanence-review>

## Interactive database

Browse the schemes, their permanence definitions, monitoring requirements, and
risk-mitigation mechanisms. Open full-screen:
